evidence: Created new product via Admin panel; using SPA (click) navigation to /products and /product/{slug}, the new product immediately appeared in product list, category view, and its own detail page without full page reload.
Edited an existing product's fields (name, price, tags, spec) via Admin panel; changes were immediately reflected in product list and detail view via SPA navigation.

issue: Tag filter list not updated with new tags
actual: After adding new tags ("adjustable-weights", "qa-edit-tag") to a product via admin, the tags correctly appear on the product's detail page and are matched by keyword search, but the Filters panel's tag chip list (34 alphabetically sorted tags) was not updated to include the new tags, making them unavailable for tag-based filtering.

evidence: Product categorization works correctly - category assigned in admin form is reflected in category pages and product detail view.
Tagging functionality (comma-separated tags field in admin form) works correctly; tags saved and displayed on product detail page.
Marking a product as Featured via toggle switch in admin form correctly surfaces it in the homepage Featured section.

actual: Created/edited products exist only in in-memory React state. After a full page reload/revisit (browser_navigate causing full reload) of admin panel or public pages, newly created/edited products disappeared entirely - changes are not persisted to any backend/storage.

evidence: Filtering and searching update results instantly client-side without requiring page reload (confirmed via keyword search and tag filter interactions).
Sort dropdown (custom combobox) correctly reorders product list immediately upon selecting an option (e.g., Price: Low to High) without page reload.

Selected two tags (coffee, vacuum) simultaneously in Filters panel; result showed 2 products (Breville Barista Express with coffee/espresso/kitchen tags, Dyson V15 Detect with vacuum/cordless/cleaning tags), confirming OR logic - each result matches at least one selected tag.

issue: Featured "View all" link does not filter to featured items
actual: Homepage Featured section correctly shows/updates featured products (marking/unmarking a product as Featured via admin toggle immediately adds/removes it from the homepage Featured section). However, clicking "View all" navigates to /products?featured=true, which displays all 9 products (unfiltered) instead of only the featured ones - the featured=true query parameter is not applied as a filter on the All Products page.

evidence: On /products page, every product card displays name, category badge, price, star rating value, brief description, product image, and a "Buy Now" purchase action link for all 9 seeded products.

Navigating to /category/tech via SPA link shows correct heading "Tech Gadgets", category combobox pre-set to "Tech Gadgets", and exactly the 3 tech products (Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra, MacBook Pro 14, Sony WH-1000XM5). Category counts on homepage (3/3/3) match.

On /products page, selecting "Fitness" in the category combobox instantly updated the displayed products (3 products found: Bowflex, Theragun, Peloton) and combobox label updated to "Fitness" without page reload, confirming category filter selection updates active category state and displayed products.

issue: Price range minimum filter does not correctly filter results
actual: Sort by Newest and Top Rated work correctly (Top Rated correctly ordered products descending by rating: 4.9,4.8,4.7,4.7,4.6,4.6,4.5,4.5,4.4). Minimum Rating filter (e.g. "4.5+ stars") correctly excludes lower-rated products. However, the Price Range minimum slider is broken: after raising the minimum to $610 via keyboard (slider showed "$610" to "$2495"), the result set still included Bowflex SelectTech 552 ($549) and Theragun Pro ($599), both priced below the $610 minimum threshold - only one product (Sony WH-1000XM5, $399) was actually excluded when count dropped from 8 to 7, indicating the price filter does not properly apply the minimum threshold to all products.

evidence: Product detail page "Buy Now" button has correct href (https://example.com/sony-xm5) matching the affiliate link entered for the product, pointing to an external retailer domain.

Category is a single-select field (one combobox, not multi-select) in the admin form; each product displays exactly one category badge (e.g., "Tech") on all views. Category counts on homepage (Tech 3, Home 3, Fitness 3) sum to exactly 9 total products with no overlap, confirming each product belongs to exactly one category.

Sony WH-1000XM5 name, category (Tech), price ($399), rating (4.8), and short description are identical across homepage, category page, all-products list, and detail page. Detail page shows full, untruncated review paragraph and all 5 key specifications (Driver Size, Battery Life, Weight, Bluetooth, Noise Cancelling).

Product tags shown on detail page (headphones, wireless, noise-cancelling, premium) match tags used in the Filters panel and are relevant to the product; category assignment is consistent between category browsing pages and the product's own detail page across all 9 seeded products checked during category/tag filtering tests.

Homepage "Editor's Top Picks" (Featured) section displays only products with Featured=true; when a product's Featured flag was toggled off via admin, it was immediately removed from the homepage Featured section, confirming featured content accuracy.
Navigating to /category/invalid-category-xyz displays a clear "Category Not Found" heading with message "The category you're looking for doesn't exist." instead of an error or blank page.

Clicking "Create Product" with all fields left blank (Name, Image URL, Affiliate Link, Short Description, no spec filled) did not create a product; a toast notification "Please fill in all required fields" appeared, the form remained open, and the product list still showed only the original 9 products - confirming publish validation blocks incomplete submissions.
